senses.gloss: ch. sameto gaze, be astonished, be waste.—Part. תָּהֵי; f. תָּהֲיָא, תָּהֲיָה.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:2">Targ. Y. Gen. I, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 12:42">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XII, 42</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 66a:4">Erub. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ בה ר׳ אלעזר</he> R. El. marvelled at it.
<cite ref="Eruvin 66a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>תְּהוּ בה וכ׳</he> the Nehardeans were astonished at it.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:7">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>תהו ביה אינשי</he> people gaze at him with ill-will (Ms. M. <he>תַּוְוהוּ בהו</he> fr. <cite ref="V00162"><he>תְּוַהּ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Niddah 66a:39">Nidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דתַהֲווּ עלך … נִתְהֲוִי עלך וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00777"><he>גִּיסָא</he> III</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 5:5">Targ. Y. Lev. V, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 5:24">24</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 5:5">Targ. Cant. V, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 13:17">Targ. Y. Ex. XIII, 17</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:25">Targ. Prov. XX, 25</cite> (ed. <cite ref="V00105"><he>תדיא</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00191"><he>חדיא</he></cite>, corr. acc.).—Y. Ḥall. II, beg. 58ᵇ <he>מן דנפקית תְּהֵית דלא אמרית וכ׳</he> (not <he>דנפקות</he>) when I was gone, I was sorry that I had not said to him &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:3:7">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שרי ת׳ ביה</he> he began to bethink himself (of what he had done).

<cite ref="Nedarim 21b:9">Ned. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>כדו תְּהֵית</he> dost thou now regret (that thou hast vowed)? Y. ib. IX, 41ᵇ bot. <he>ר״י פתח ות׳</he> R. J. offered an opening (for the purpose of absolving from a vow), and he (the vower) expressed his regret; [read:] <he>ואילולי דו ת׳ הו אתי</he> but if he were not sorry for his vow, would he have come (before the teacher for absolution)?; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:6">B. Bath. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>פוק תְּהֵי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01616"><he>קַנְקַנָּא</he></cite>.
